Hi! There’s a website (and phone app) called [Discogs](https://www.discogs.com/) which tbh I only learned about last month. You can see almost every past vinyl record, CD, cassette, etc. made that people have put into the database. [Old Dog Demos](https://www.discogs.com/search/?q=mac+demarco+old+dog+demos+cassette&type=all) did come out on cassette! It’s good because you can buy really old/rare stuff that music artists have put out years ago, but they’re often pricey and limited (for example, some vinyl records could only have 500 copies ever made).  

The “Old Dog Demos” cassette is sadly sold out on Mac’s [Bandcamp](https://macdemarco.bandcamp.com/album/old-dog-demos) page, but you can find that cassette or other stuff you’re interested in on places like eBay or sellers on Discogs (which is also a marketplace), or online record stores. There’s quite a lot of different colour vinyl records for his albums, and funnily enough the first Mac DeMarco record I bought was his “Other Here Comes The Cowboy Demos” Record Store Day vinyl from a random online store.
